notes.title: Attention BATs!
notes.notes:
Today, the [b]31st of August[/b], our game BatTap will finally be released on Steam!  We worked long and hard on it.‼️

What's in store for you:  Learn something new. Unique items to collect in your inventory.  Constant updates and support [b]is just the beginning of our journey![/b]

 Don't miss your chance to be one of the first to join our game! 

Share your impressions and invite your friends to join the adventure! Your feedback will help us make the game even better!

Thanks for your patience and support!
